meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对比本地代码与 npm 已发布版本,读取每次提交的真实改动,按三个发布层列出未发布变更,并给出各层及整体的版本号升级建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等触发词,或要求查看未发布更新、变更日志时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的变更
say.note: Claude 会对比已发布版本并列出变更。

say.text: 按发布层整理一份变更日志
say.note: Claude 会分三个发布层汇总未发布改动。

say.text: 检查这次有没有破坏性变更

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compares the local codebase against the latest published npm versions, reads the actual diffs for each commit, lists unpublished changes classified into three release layers, and recommends version bumps per layer and overall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords such as 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', or 'what changed', or asks to review unpublished updates or changelog.

say_en.note: Claude compares published versions and lists changes.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog by release layer
say_en.note: Claude summarizes unpublished changes in three layers.
Claude flags breaking changes per layer with version advice.
